name: Windows Brute Force Detection
description: Detects multiple failed logon attempts within a short time window indicating brute force or password spraying
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 | stats count by src_ip, user | where count > 10

name: LSASS Memory Access Detection
description: Detects processes accessing LSASS memory which may indicate credential dumping attempts
spl: index=windows sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=10 TargetImage="*\\lsass.exe" | stats count by SourceImage, SourceUser | where count > 0

name: PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
description: Detects PowerShell execution with encoded commands which may indicate obfuscation
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational" EventCode=4104 | regex ScriptBlockText="(?i)-enc[odedcommand]*" | stats count by ComputerName, UserName

name: Scheduled Task Creation
description: Detects creation of new scheduled tasks which may be used for persistence
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4698 | stats count by TaskName, SubjectUserName, ComputerName

name: Registry Run Key Modification
description: Detects modifications to registry run keys used for persistence
spl: index=windows sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=13 TargetObject="*\\CurrentVersion\\Run*" | stats count by Image, TargetObject, Details

name: Event Log Clearing
description: Detects clearing of Windows event logs which may indicate cover-up activity
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=1102 | stats count by SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName

name: Azure AD Impossible Travel
description: Detects sign-ins from geographically distant locations in short time periods
spl: index=azure sourcetype="azure:aad:signin" ResultType=0 | iplocation Location | stats earliest(_time) as first_login, latest(_time) as last_login, dc(Location) as unique_locations by UserPrincipalName | where unique_locations > 1

name: O365 Mailbox Forwarding Rule
description: Detects creation of mailbox forwarding rules which may indicate data exfiltration
spl: index=o365 sourcetype="o365:management:activity" Operation="Set-InboxRule" OR Operation="New-InboxRule" | search ForwardTo=* OR RedirectTo=* | stats count by UserId, ForwardTo, RedirectTo

name: AWS IAM Policy Attachment
description: Detects attachment of policies to IAM users which may indicate privilege escalation
spl: index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" eventName="AttachUserPolicy" OR eventName="PutUserPolicy" | stats count by userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.policyArn

name: Windows Service Creation
description: Detects creation of new Windows services which may indicate persistence or privilege escalation
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:System" EventCode=7045 | stats count by ServiceName, ImagePath, ServiceType

name: PsExec Lateral Movement
description: Detects PsExec usage patterns indicating potential lateral movement
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=5145 RelativeTargetName="PSEXESVC*" | stats count by SubjectUserName, IpAddress, ShareName

name: RDP Logon from External IP
description: Detects Remote Desktop logons from external IP addresses
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 LogonType=10 | where NOT cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8", src_ip) | stats count by src_ip, TargetUserName, ComputerName

name: Kerberoasting TGS Request
description: Detects Kerberos service ticket requests with RC4 encryption indicating potential Kerberoasting
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4769 TicketEncryptionType=0x17 | stats count by TargetUserName, ServiceName, IpAddress | where count > 5

name: Windows Defender Tampering
description: Detects attempts to disable Windows Defender real-time protection
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational" EventCode=5001 OR EventCode=5007 | stats count by ComputerName

name: DNS Tunneling High Entropy
description: Detects potential DNS tunneling through high-entropy subdomain queries
spl: index=dns sourcetype="stream:dns" | eval query_length=len(query) | where query_length > 50 | stats count by src_ip, query | where count > 100

name: Azure AD App Consent Grant
description: Detects OAuth application consent grants which may enable persistence
spl: index=azure sourcetype="azure:aad:audit" activityDisplayName="Consent to application" | stats count by initiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName, targetResources{}.displayName

name: AWS Security Group Wide Open
description: Detects security group rules allowing inbound traffic from any IP
spl: index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" eventName="AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress" | spath requestParameters.ipPermissions.items{}.ipRanges.items{}.cidrIp | search "0.0.0.0/0" | stats count by userIdentity.arn

name: Process Injection Detection
description: Detects potential process injection through remote thread creation
spl: index=windows sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=8 | stats count by SourceImage, TargetImage, SourceUser

name: WMI Remote Execution
description: Detects WMI-based remote command execution
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4688 CommandLine="*wmic*/node:*" | stats count by ParentImage, CommandLine, SubjectUserName

name: Account Discovery Commands
description: Detects execution of account enumeration commands
spl: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4688 | regex CommandLine="(?i)(net user|net localgroup|whoami|Get-ADUser)" | stats count by SubjectUserName, CommandLine
